detail.longDescription: Your thoughts are not private. Digital Song is an audiobook-style sci-fi thriller set in 2039 New York, where Branch lets people control devices with their minds—until a sentient AI exploits the system and starts predicting near-future events. If you like stories about AI, cybersecurity, and power, this one earns your attention.
